name: Theme and variations
summary: One motif, rewritten in every section: upside down, slower, faster, in a new register, never the same twice.
motif: The theme is stated plainly in the first section; every later section is one way of rewriting it.
surprise: One variation so far from the theme that it is only recognised by its rhythm.
ending: The theme once more, plainly, but now under the harmony of the last variation.
